ecosystem.title: Three pieces, one goal.
ecosystem.lead: Everything your library needs in three applications that talk to each other: the API that holds the data, the panel the staff uses, and the app the readers love.
ecosystem.pillar.api.title: LumiLivre API
ecosystem.pillar.api.desc: Robust Spring Boot backend with PostgreSQL and Supabase. All clients consume the same documented REST API.
ecosystem.pillar.web.title: LumiLivre Web
ecosystem.pillar.web.desc: React admin panel for librarians and coordination. Full management of collection, loans, readers and reports.
ecosystem.pillar.app.title: LumiLivre App
ecosystem.pillar.app.desc: Flutter app for readers to discover books, reserve titles, check loans and compete in the reading ranking.
features.title: Everything you expected — and what you didn't.
features.lead: Not a glorified spreadsheet. It's real software, designed by people who use a library every day.
features.item.catalog.title: Smart cataloguing
features.item.catalog.desc: Type the ISBN, search by title or paste the cover photo. LumiLivre automatically fills title, author, publisher, year and synopsis via Google Books and BrasilAPI. Cataloguing a thousand books takes an afternoon, not a semester.
features.item.loans.title: Loans and fines
features.item.loans.desc: Automatic renewals, overdue alerts and penalty calculations configurable per school.
features.item.app.title: Reader app
features.item.app.desc: Digital catalogue, reservations, history and reading ranking — straight from the phone.
features.item.tcc.title: Thesis repository
features.item.tcc.desc: Final-year projects indexed with PDF, committee, advisor and keywords. Your school's intellectual collection, searchable.
features.item.emails.title: Automatic emails
features.item.emails.desc: Confirmations, return reminders and notices without manual intervention.
features.item.reports.title: PDF reports
features.item.reports.desc: Export statistics, ranking, inventory and accountability with a single click.
screens.title: Meet the main screens
screens.subtitle: A complete platform for the school library — from the collection to reader engagement.
screens.dashboard.title: Real-time management overview
screens.dashboard.desc: KPIs, loan charts, top books and overdue items — all on one screen, with report export.
screens.books.title: Full catalogue with copies
screens.books.desc: ISBN search, list or grid view, copy management and advanced filters.
screens.loans.title: Frictionless loans and returns
screens.loans.desc: Control of checkouts, due dates and overdue items, with automatic email notifications to readers.
screens.ranking.title: Engagement that drives reading
screens.ranking.desc: Reader ranking by course, module and shift, with community participation charts.
screens.reports.title: Print-ready reports
screens.reports.desc: Export loans, copies and statistics to PDF, in Portuguese or English.
stack.title: Modern stack, chosen with care.
stack.lead: Stable, well-documented and popular tools — a solid, maintainable foundation.
